item.title: Badly damaged pavement on both sides of Burrell Street, 30th July
item.description:
The heavy plant going into and out of the 220 Blackfriars building side 10 hours as day has caused all the itemised damage. The pavement on both sides of Burrell Street is very seriously damaged to the extent that the pavements are a health and safety issue. It's not just damaged as in cracked, but collapsing with drops of between 2 and 3 inches at various points. This really needs urgent attention. The site traffic has also destroyed one tree which was so badly damaged they took a chainsaw to it and have also decimated the one on the corner of Chancel Street. The whole area is being systematically decimated.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 230, Blackfriars Road, Southwark, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
